title: Do Verifier Judgments Survive Abstraction? Measuring Verification Transport for LLM Agent Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18471v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based verifiers are increasingly used to evaluate agent executions, but their reliability is typically measured under a single representation of the trajectory. In deployed agent systems, the same execution may be exposed through composed tools, delegation boundaries, or compacted histories, changing what execution evidence is directly observable to the verifier. It therefore remains unclear whether correct verifier judgments persist across such abstraction boundaries. We introduce Verification Transport, a reliability test that measures judgment stability under abstraction-induced changes in execution observability. We construct matched native, abstracted, and restored views of the same frozen executions while holding the task, realized trajectory, outcome, ground truth, evaluation criterion, and verifier fixed. translated_title: 验证器的判断能否经受住抽象化？面向LLM智能体评估的验证迁移测量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.18471v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：基于LLM的验证器被越来越多地用于评估智能体的执行过程，但其可靠性通常只在轨迹的单一表示形式下进行测量。在部署的智能体系统中，同一次执行可能通过组合工具、委托边界或压缩的历史记录等方式暴露出来，这改变了验证器可直接观察到的执行证据。因此，正确的验证器判断是否能在这些抽象边界之间保持一致，目前仍不清楚。我们提出了“验证迁移”（Verification Transport），这是一种可靠性测试，用于测量在抽象引起的执行可观察性变化下判断的稳定性。我们在保持任务、实际执行轨迹、结果、真值、评估标准和验证器全部固定不变的前提下，构建了同一次冻结执行的匹配的原生视图、抽象视图和恢复视图。我们在四个智能体评估基准、七种验证器骨干、四种验证协议和三种抽象操作（实验在摘要中被截断）上进行了测试。
tldr: 本文提出“验证迁移”（Verification Transport）这一可靠性测试方法，通过在保持任务、轨迹、结果等条件不变的情况下构建原生、抽象和恢复三种匹配视图，测量LLM验证器的判断在经历工具组合、委托边界、历史压缩等抽象化后是否仍能保持稳定可靠。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Verification Transport, a reliability test that measures whether LLM verifier judgments remain stable across abstraction boundaries (composed tools, delegation, compacted histories) by constructing matched native, abstracted, and restored views of frozen executions while holding task, trajectory, outcome, and verifier fixed.
